policy: All regular evidence files, independent of passed/failed/interrupted status; only listed binaries/cache/spools excluded. Original input/log/VTU/CSV/partition/receipt bytes are unchanged.
tar_metadata_policy: Paths relative to evidence root under fsi-scale-01/; uid/gid/mtime=0 and mode0644 for deterministic transport; original mode/mtime retained per file.
source_provenance_policy: Actual build/source/driver/binary provenance remains in each original receipt; archive creation time is not a source/build assertion.
